## Summary

I resolved ticket T-4004 by investigating the notification-worker DNS failures. The root cause was that the smtp-relay service was moved to the shared-infra namespace on Sunday, but the notification-worker is still configured to connect to `smtp-relay` (unqualified name), which only works within the same namespace. The fix is to update the SMTP_HOST configuration to use the namespace-qualified name `smtp-relay.shared-infra` so the pod can reach the service across namespaces.
